who.value: seller with an active store (Selling tab default)

job.value: check how selling is going and jump to sales, listings or insights

arrivedFrom.value: the Me tab in the bottom bar

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'My account', the profile row and the 'Selling' / 'Buying' tabs make it the account hub.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: For a hub there's no single action, but the 'Me page just got an upgrade!' card with 'Start >' sits above Insights and My sales and draws the eye first.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Start >' doesn't say what starts, and 'To start' under My sales is ambiguous next to 'In progress' and 'Returns'.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Revenue (AI-estimated)' and 'Revenue vs spend (Feb)' need the info icon to be understood.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: Nothing is asked of the seller beyond navigating.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Revenue and spend figures are shown up front in Insights, while sales are summarised as counts behind 'My sales >'.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: The 'Me page just got an upgrade!' announcement serves only returning users, and pushes the seller's own content down.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Counts, badges and the two money figures carry it; the only prose is the two-line upgrade card.
